title: Cookie Policy
description: Which cookies the pointet.fr marketplace uses, what they are for, how long they are stored and how to manage them.

paragraph: This policy explains which cookies the pointet.fr marketplace uses, what they are for and how to manage them. For information on how we process personal data, see the
Cookies are small pieces of data that a website stores in your browser. They make it possible to recognise a session between requests and to remember your settings and the contents of your basket.
We use only cookies that are strictly necessary for the operation of the service you request. There are no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies on the website.

head: Cookie
Purpose
Lifetime
rows: Access token (JWT): confirms your identity for protected requests
Refresh token (JWT): extends the session without signing in again; it is replaced on each refresh and the previous one is revoked

paragraph: These cookies have the HttpOnly attribute (they are not accessible to JavaScript in the browser), are sent only over HTTPS (the Secure attribute) and use SameSite=Lax. They contain session credentials, not advertising identifiers.

blocks.heading: Guest cookies (for users who are not signed in)

head: Cookie
Purpose
Lifetime
rows: Stores the contents of your basket while you are not signed in to an account
Guest session identifier: allows a guest to view their orders and pre-orders without registering. Has the HttpOnly attribute

paragraph: Once you have signed in to your account, your basket, orders and pre-orders are stored on the server and linked to your account.

head: Cookie
Purpose
Lifetime
rows: Remembers the website language you have selected; contains only the language code
Up to 12 months from the time the language is selected

sections.title: Why we do not ask for consent

paragraph: Under Article 82 of the French Data Protection Act (Loi Informatique et Libertés) and the recommendations of the CNIL, consent is not required for cookies that are strictly necessary to provide a service expressly requested by the user: authentication, the basket, viewing your own orders and language selection. All our cookies fall into this category, so no consent banner is displayed.
If we add analytics or advertising cookies, we will update this policy in advance and ask for your consent.

Payment takes place on a secure page of the payment provider Stripe. On its own page, Stripe may set its own cookies that are necessary to process the payment and to prevent fraud; those cookies are governed by Stripe's policy.
Following external links (for example, to WhatsApp or Instagram) is subject to the rules of those services.
You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. The consequences are as follows:

list: without the authentication cookies, you will not be able to sign in to your account or stay signed in;
without the guest cookies, a guest's basket and list of orders will not be kept between visits;
without the language cookie, the website will open in the default language.

paragraph: Signing out of your account deletes the authentication cookies in the current browser.
We update this policy whenever the set of cookies changes; the date of the last update is shown at the top of the document. Please send any questions to
